parameters.name: AddWatermark
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to add a watermark. Valid values:

- False (default): Does not add a watermark.
- True: Adds a watermark.

parameters.name: ImageURL
parameters.description:
The URL of the face image to be fused. This parameter is used only in single-face template scenarios. We recommend that you use an OSS URL in the China (Shanghai) region. For local files or OSS URLs in other regions, see [File URL processing](~~155645~~).
Input limits:
- Image format: JPG, JPEG, or PNG.
- Image size: No more than 20 MB.
- Image resolution: At least 128 × 128 pixels and at most 2000 × 2000 pixels. The longest side must not exceed 2000 pixels.
- The URL must not contain Chinese characters.

> - If the image resolution exceeds the maximum limit, resize the image first. For more information, see [Image resizing](~~44688~~).
- Specify either **ImageURL** or **MergeInfos**.

sub_parameters.name: ImageURL
sub_parameters.description: The URL of the image to replace the face.

sub_parameters.name: TemplateFaceID
sub_parameters.description: The sub-ID of a specific face in the multi-face template.

parameters.name: ModelVersion
parameters.description: The model version. Two model versions are available: face shape adaptation (v1) and non-face shape adaptation (v2), which produce different results. Default value: v1 (face shape adaptation version).

parameters.name: TemplateId
parameters.description:
The template ID of the face template.

> You must upload a template first. For more information, see [AddFaceImageTemplate](~~203512~~).

parameters.name: WatermarkType
parameters.description:
The watermark type. Valid values:

- EN (default): English watermark.
- CN: Chinese watermark.
